lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'm making an *announcement*!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I'm gonna squash you... like the bug. You. Are.

lines.speaker: Continuity Announcer
lines.text: ...to decide it all.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Are you filming up there?

lines.speaker: Continuity Announcer
lines.text: Join us as it all comes together... AT THE #CELLGAMES, ONLY ON ZTV!

lines.speaker: Continuity Announcer
lines.text: With your boy, Jimmy Firecracker, reporting live on-site, as the mighty Mister Satan takes on the sinister Cell, in a no-holds-barred fight for the fate of the world!

lines.speaker: Continuity Announcer
lines.text: Will it be humanity's last stand?! Or will the devil get his due?!

lines.speaker: Continuity Announcer
lines.text: Find out this Sunday at the Cell Games! Presented by HETAP.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Got my wristbands on and my boots are tied ♫

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Gonna grab my friends and fight a bug guy ♫

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Doo, doo-doo, today is Fightin' Day ♫

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Goku!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, Chi-Chi! You comin' with?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: What? No! I...

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Ughh... look...

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: You've already died once.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I can take that.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I can make peace with that.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: You're a fighter; and to be honest... it's why I fell in love with you.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: But Gohan?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: *Not* Gohan...

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Not our baby boy.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Chi-Chi, come on, don't be like that!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Goku...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If Gohan dies, that means the world's doomed anyway - so, what will it matter?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: OK, for the record, we know that I'm not great at this... but you know what I'm *good* at?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Leaving?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *Fighting*~!
POP

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Agghhh...

lines.speaker: Ox-King
lines.text: Maybe I'll get lucky and Cell and him will just kill each-other.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: *Daddy*!

lines.speaker: Ox-King
lines.text: Sweetie, I can only afford to support *two* Saiyan mouths, and you've got a bun in the oven.
POP

lines.speaker: All Others
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, guys! Ha ha!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Y'all ready for the... for-- for the... tournament...?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow, did someone die?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh gosh, where's Yamcha?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Nobody's dead!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *Yet*.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then why are you all so glum, chums?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Come on! Today is Fightin' Day!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Goku, last time I fought Cell, he basically Tambourine'd me.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: And he's gone through two transformations since we fought, so... still trying to come to terms on that one, really.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Long story short: We're basically just going for moral support.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, I know. But I'm just so excited, guys! I finally get to *punch him*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Right in his handsome face!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *Why* do you keep calling him "handsome"?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Because that jawline don't lie and neither do I!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now let's go! I don't want nobody gettin' a swing at Cell before me!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ah, sure. Like anyone else would be *dumb* enough to show up...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Jimmy Firecracker here, live from the Cell Games, presented by HETAP!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Because apparently nobody else would take this job.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: But don't worry about me. Because Jimmy Firecrack corn and he don't give a f**k!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: He'll take any job! He'll take every job! He'll take YOUR job!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: And speaking of jobs... nobody else is here yet.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Will Jimmy Firecracker have to get in that ring?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Does Jimmy Firecracker gotta come down there *and SLAP that perfect jawline*?!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: It looks like Cell is saved the wrath of Jimmy Firecracker as his first opponent has arrived.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: I'm receiving words that This. Is. Him, Folks! The Man! The Legend! The Winner Of The 24th World Martial Arts Tournament!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: MISTERR SATANNNN!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Maybe shouldn't have made this an open invite...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: The Champ has stepped up into the ring!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Better update that TV-PG to TV-MA, 'cuz you're about to see a *full-blown-massacre*!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Wait, what's this?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: The Champ is calling us down!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Come on, Larry! What do I always say?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Where there's smoke, there's Firecracker, sir!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Yer goddang right!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Mr. Satan, sir!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: What do you have to say to your adoring public?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: First, to all the kids at home:

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: *Do not* recreate the violence you are about to see.
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Unless you buy the new *Mr. Satan Action Figure*!
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: On sale now, in stores everywhere!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: And why, Mr. Satan, have you come here today?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Well, aside from being sponsored by HETAP, MR. SATAN NEVER BACKS DOWN FROM A CHALLENGE!
Crowd cheers
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Not when it comes to evil! Vile! Wretched! Contemptible! Wicked! Monstrous! Inhuman! Dishonorable! Nefarious...!
Crowd cheers
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *Definitely* shouldn't have made this an open invite...!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, hey! It's Tenshinhan and Yamcha!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hiya, guys? How ya doin'?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Just heading towards the arena.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Vegeta passed us earlier; flipped us off. So that was a good way to start the morning.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, but we totally flipped him off back.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: *I* flipped him off back. You just waved and laughed nervously.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Look, I don't have your mutually-sustained hate-boner for the guy, OK?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: I don't have a *hate-boner* for him.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Dude, it's a pretty hateful boner.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: ...Baneful! Iniquitous! Execrable...! *Villain like you*!
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Now... what d'ya haf'ta say ta THAT?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Oh, what's the matter? Satan gotch'er tongue?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Are you sure about this?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Speak up, bug-boy!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You look like an extra from a budget porno flick.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: The kind where *everyone* gets tested afterwards. Even the cameramen.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Oh... um, you're--

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Did they find you in the subway?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Were you homeless?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Did you get your start in bum fights?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: This is getting oddly personal...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Do you have any actual friends?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Any relationships at all that aren't about your money or your position?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: ...I have a daughter.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, that poor orphan.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: C--can we can we cut to commercial?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Another man has just touched down at the arena!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Uh-uh-sir! Are you looking to take on the terrifying Perfect Cell?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Get that mic out of my face before I give you a colonoscopy with your camera.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Message received, violent stranger!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Answer the question, Prince!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Do you plan to take me on?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because I'm ready to throw down when you are, buddy!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Come on, let's toss you through a mountain or five for old times' sake.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: ...The old "silent treatment", is it?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Don't tell me you came all the way out here just to stand around and look mean~! (Chuckles)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Ohhh~, I see! You took my advice~!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Growling)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You're waiting for...

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Goku!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: My dear Android 16!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: How *wonderful* for you to join us today!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Are you here for--

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Goku!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Of course; your little murder-crush.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: And another mysterious stranger has appeared from thin air!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Where do these people keep coming from?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: And who does their hair?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Obviously they're just hidin' behind rocks, waitin' to make their dramatic entrances, and usin' cranes and wires to make it look like they're flyin'.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Similar to the practical effects we used in Skygina II: Mr. Satan vs. Dr. Brain-Man!
Crowd cheers
Crowd cheers

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: In theatres Friday!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Will you be participating in the Games as well, Sixteen?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Or are you just going to sit on the sidelines like the Prince over here?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hmmm!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: GOKU!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: OK, are you seriously just gonna say his name over and over?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: HE IS HERE!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And our roster is complete.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I hope this day finds you well, Son Goku.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Slept a little weird on my arm, but, yeah.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I see you've brought the whole gang along to witness our battle.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Piccolo, Trunks...*Tenshinhan*.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Ki-ko-how ya doing?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *Perfect*.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And Yamcha! What a surprise! How's it going, man?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh, uh, good...

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: I brought towels and water bottles.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And like that, you've already contributed more than Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Hello, little duckling.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: He-hey, Sixteen! Looks like they fixed up your dome real nice, huh buddy?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Indeed. I am now operating at 100% efficiency.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And for some reason, register 10 kilograms lighter.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Good on ya, buddy! Ya look great!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, hi! I'm Son Goku! Who are you?
♫ I Have Waited So Long ♫

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ I have waited oh so long ♫

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ Please don't tell me baby ♫

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ I was wrong ♫

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ Dreaming of you every night ♫

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ Holding back until the time was right ♫

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ♫ I've counted the days ♫
Music cuts-off

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...This guy's *intense*.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Yeah, uh, I get paid for every second I'm on camera, so if we could just--

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Excuse me, sir? Are you or any of your freakish-looking friends participating in the tournament today?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh yeah! I'ma go punch that Cell a lot!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: In fact, if you don't mind, I'ma gun go do that right now!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: *OK, enough*!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Aah!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: F**k!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I am not playing second-fiddle to a buncha gym rats with too much time on their hands!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: *I* am the World Martial Arts Champion, and *I* will be the one to defeat Cell!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (Gasp!)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: There was a tournament?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You won a tournament?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *I* WON A TOURNAMENT!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That means he's even stronger than Krillin!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait, hold u-- uh, why me specifically?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Dang it, and I really wanted a turn!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh well. I guess we'll just have to let *The Champ* handle it.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Are you for real right now?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah - he's The Champ! He's got this.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I can't tell if he's serious - and that's very concerning.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Good! Now that we have rank all sorted out,

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I think it's about time I teach Cell where he falls: Specifically at my feet!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: When I, Mr. Satan, end this little freak-show, once and for--

lines.speaker: Piiza
lines.text: Hope y'all ready to get down and dirty with the three hottest stars from the Y Network!

lines.speaker: Piiza
lines.text: (Y'all ready?)

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: What's this? New challengers from the bitter rivals of ZTV?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Like we don't got enough knuckleheads hoggin' mah spotlight!

lines.speaker: Piiza
lines.text: Coming to you live from the Cell Games Arena, it's Piiza!

lines.speaker: Piroshiki
lines.text: Piroshiki!

lines.speaker: Caroni
lines.text: And Caroni!

lines.speaker: Caroni
lines.text: And we are--

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: ...Did those people just die??

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Pfft! Don't be an idiot, Jimmy.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Obviously that was just an unmanned remote-controlled cargo robot with a voice-recordi--

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: ...and filled with fake cadavers for added effect!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I'll give 'em points for effort, tho.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Mr. Satan ain't no one's fool!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Go Champ!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Grrrrrh!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: If we're lucky, it'll be that quick with this Satan guy, uh?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, people are dying and we're just watching.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yup!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Now, Cell... if that is your real name...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: It's actually *Perfect* Cell--

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: IT'S ACTUALLY "GARBAGE"!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: And Mr. Satan's gonna take out the trash.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Wait, you were serious?! You're actually gonna *fight*?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I thought you were just somebody's hype man.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I AM THE HYPE!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: KILL HIM!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Now try to get this on camera, Gary!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: L-- Larry.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: 'Cus I'm gonna end this in a single blow, and it's gonna be *faster than light*!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: SATAN... PUUUU--!
{BWOOOSH} {Splat}
Spllllsh
Splllsh
Krpsh
♫ I Have Waited So Long ♫
Fade-out

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Hello my name is Sixteen may I please kill you?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [To Krillin] Hold on. What'cha say?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ...Nothing.
